claim_gate.recording_and_action_chain: must reproduce through forecast_annotation_workflow._selected_requests; endpoint positions must rederive from hash-bound native observation payloads and history intervals from native camera/physics timestamps
claim_gate.development_release_freeze: must validate through freeze_development_release.validate_release_freeze and exactly bind the selected alignment contracts, rubric, development label summary and final consensus, exact usability decision, movement threshold, analysis seed, sample rule, and measured resource budget
claim_gate.failure_mode: no forecast metric is emitted when any prerequisite is missing, unhashed, inconsistent, or not confirmation-stage

analysis.request_weighting: mean within episode, equally over four conditions, equally over independent layout pairs
analysis.continuous_missingness: defined only on layout pairs with all four condition means observable
analysis.win_bounds: strict forecast wins; unresolved selected requests are non-wins then wins; zero-eligible, invalid, censored-with-no-selection, and unrun cells contribute [0,1]

primary.forecast_error: Euclidean distance between executed and predicted cube-minus-bowl image vectors divided by image diagonal
primary.persistence_error: Euclidean distance between executed and current cube-minus-bowl image vectors divided by image diagonal
primary.sign_policy: retain either sign; positive favors forecast

baselines.constant_velocity: last two timestamped observations only; request zero reduces to persistence
baselines.missing_history: explicitly unavailable; never inferred from future imagery

stopping_control.censoring: never carry a last state forward to action 450

movement.threshold_source: exact development duplicate-label q95 from validated confirmation freeze
movement.moving_rule: actual normalized relative displacement strictly greater than threshold
movement.stationary_rule: actual normalized relative displacement less than or equal to threshold

coverage: per condition: complete request inventory, timing/camera/action eligibility, ineligibility reasons, zero-eligible episodes, recording status/censor reasons, selected localization and ambiguity coverage
earlier_horizon: use only the exact frozen early_horizon object; distinguish no qualified target from qualified but human-consensus-unobservable evidence
model_sample_size_table: include the full hash-bound model configuration, frozen alignment fields, and separate planned/valid-complete/valid-censored/technical-invalid/unrun counts
annotation_quality: report exact first-pass agreement and independent-adjudication image counts and rates, bound to the final consensus, restricted map, adjudication map, anonymous rater-code hashes, and response artifact hashes
example_selection: For each included model and condition, choose the valid-complete cell minimizing SHA256(analysis_seed NUL model NUL condition NUL cell_id); do not use labels, errors, success, or visual outcomes.
